ios.desc:
Pixeen — Flyer, Poster & Banner Maker with AI & Premium Templates

Create stunning flyers, posters and banners in minutes - even with no design experience.
Built for small businesses, marketers, event organizers, and content creators, Pixeen helps you create professional marketing visuals that attract attention and drive real results.

Design faster. Look premium. Stand out everywhere.
Start Fast with Beautiful Templates

Choose from hand-picked, modern templates for:
Business promotions
Sales & discount offers
Events & invitations
Product ads & promotional posters
Social media posts
Menus, price lists, and more

Every template is crafted to look clean, modern, and business-ready.

Easy Editing. Powerful Results.
Edit designs with a simple, intuitive graphic design editor:
Change text, images, colors, and layouts
Add graphics, shapes, and stickers
Fine-tune every detail — without complexity
Get professional-quality results — without hiring a designer.

AI Flyer Generator — Simple & Smart

Create eye-catching posters using simple words — no complex prompts needed.
Generate designs in any size, color, or style
Upload your own image or let AI create visuals
AI writes headlines, subheadings, descriptions, and image ideas
Get 4 unique design options instantly
Pick one and customize everything
Perfect for quick ideas, instant inspiration, and fast results.

100% Editable AI Designs

Edit everything — text, fonts, photos, colors, layers, and layout.
Nothing is locked. You stay in full creative control.
Apply Your Brand in One Tap
Use Brand Kits to apply your logo, brand colors, and fonts, keeping every design consistent, recognizable, and professional.

Download & Share in Seconds

Export high-quality, print-ready designs or optimized visuals for social media, ads, and marketing — instantly.
Fast downloads. Sharp quality. Ready to publish.
Built for Speed. Designed for Business.
Save time. Reduce design costs. Create visuals that look premium, attract customers, and help your business grow.

Start Creating Designs That Convert
Download Pixeen and create posters, flyers, and banners that stand out, build your brand, and drive results.

Pixeen is an AI-powered design platform built for small businesses and entrepreneurs to create professional marketing creatives quickly. It helps users generate posters, ads, and social media designs in minutes while maintaining brand consistency across all platforms.

App Link: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6758160521?pt=128443847&ct=yc&mt=8

Pixeen also produces marketing content such as captions and campaign ideas, reducing manual work and saving time.
Our focus is on simplifying design and marketing so businesses can scale without needing dedicated design teams.
